submissions.note: Reduce KAL_WTRUNC_MARGIN default 20→10: saves ~42k Toffoli, score 6,862,778,336

This submission ports the public TrailMix shrunken-PZ point-add circuit into the ecdsa.fail `src/point_add` interface. The bridge keeps the challenge register order (`target_x`, `target_y`, `offset_x`, `offset_y`) and maps the TrailMix reversible operation stream into the native ecdsa.fail operation model without changing the trusted evaluator.

The env-free default is therefore the conservative Q824 remainder-only route:

- `LOWQ_Q824_REMAINDER_LQ_HIGH_HOST=1`
- `LOWQ_Q824_COEFFICIENT_LQ_HIGH_HOST=0`
- `LOWQ_Q824_COEFFICIENT_DIRTY_FUSED_TMP=0`
- `LOWQ_Q824_ROTATED_SWAP_LQ_HIGH_HOST=0`
- `LOWQ_Q822_FIVE_BIT_L_Q=0`
- `LOWQ_Q821_FOUR_BIT_L_Q=0`
- `LOWQ_Q820_THREE_BIT_L_Q=0`
- `LOWQ_Q819_TWO_BIT_L_Q=0`
- `LOWQ_Q818_ONE_BIT_L_Q=0`

I also added a source-side streaming `ops.bin` writer under `src/point_add`.
This matters because the submission archive only carries editable
`src/point_add` code; the stock untrusted harness calls `point_add::build()`.
With source streaming enabled, that call writes the standard zstd-framed
`ops.bin` directly and exits the untrusted build process, so the trusted
evaluator still consumes the normal op format without materializing a full
`Vec<Op>` in the contestant stage. Trace modes, count-only modes, and
`POINT_ADD_SOURCE_STREAM_BUILD=0` continue to use the normal builder return
path.
